title: Strawberries and Cream Buttercream
description: Strawberries and cream cheese combine for a sweet and fluffy buttercream frosting that tastes like a strawberry smoothie and is perfect for icing cupcakes!
ingredients: 7 cups confectioners' sugar, or more as needed
0.25 cup frozen sliced strawberries in sugar, thawed
1 drop red food coloring, or as desired

steps.text: Beat cream cheese and butter together in a mixing bowl using an electric mixer until smooth and creamy. Add 1 cup confectioner's sugar, strawberries, strawberry extract, vanilla extract, and red food coloring. Mix on medium speed until smooth. Gradually add remaining confectioner's sugar, 1 cup at a time as needed, until desired consistency is reached.
